title: Airbnb Superhost rating fragility and badge rates, 2026
description:
Two measurements over Airbnb listings with 10 or more reviews in 123 cities across 37 countries, built from Inside Airbnb's public June 2026 snapshots.

Fragility: of listings whose all-time rating clears Airbnb's 4.8 Superhost line, how many would fall below it after a single 1-star review (44.0% of 541,244 listings above 4.8).

Badge vs rating: how many listings at each all-time rating actually hold the Superhost badge (25.1% of listings below 4.8 do; 33.4% of those at or above it do not).

Per-city and per-country CSVs, full JSON results and two charts. Method and limitations (all-time vs trailing-12-month rating, quarterly lag, listing rather than host as the unit) are in the README. Full write-up: https://stellarreply.com/blog/airbnb-superhost-fragility-study.html
